Product:{\"sku\":\"7100140584\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Branded a traitor and hunted by the Agency he once served, Agent 47 returns in lethal form.

Stalk your targets through elaborate environments designed to reward both quick thinking and patient planning. Strike silently from the shadows, or let your silverballers do the talking — whatever your approach, each of Absolution’s 20 missions is a contract killer’s hunting ground that invites exploration, experimentation and improvisation.

STUNNING EXECUTION ON NINTENDO SWITCH™ 2

• Increased output resolution in both Handheld and TV Mode for clearer visuals, wherever you play.
• Smoother action, thanks to frame rate improvements in Handheld Mode, to a maximum of 60 FPS.
• Joy-Con™ 2 Mouse Controls for pinpoint accuracy.
• Improved animations and visual effects in the busiest scenes.
• Enhanced Level of Detail (LoD) for distant objects, plus shadow quality and texture filtering improvements that make environments feel alive.

MORE THAN A NUMBER
The story of Hitman: Absolution puts Agent 47’s character under the spotlight, where his loyalties and his conscience are both put to the test.

KILLER INSTINCT
Use Instinct Mode to identify targets, predict enemy movements, and highlight points of interest.

CLEAR YOUR PATH
Point Shooting lets you stop time, mark multiple enemies, and eliminate them in a heartbeat.

MASTER THE CRAFT
Find new ways to take out your marks, complete Challenges, and perfect your technique.

PLAY IT AGAIN AND AGAIN
Choose from 5 different difficulty settings, from easy to the insanely hard Purist mode.

CONTRACTS MODE
Hitman’s unlimited sandbox mode — take on player-designed contracts from other agents around the world, or create and share your own.
